title: Yummy Tunisian Chestnut Grill
description: A jammy, juicy, cozy Tunisian dish featuring cooked chestnuts glazed with aromatic spices and grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Rinse the chestnuts and place them in a pot with 200ml water and 1 tsp salt.
Bring the water to a boil, then simmer the chestnuts for 20 minutes until they are tender.
Drain the chestnuts and peel them while still warm.
Pat the peeled chestnuts dry with a clean towel.
In a small bowl mix the olive oil, cumin, paprika, coriander, cayenne, mint, lemon juice, and parsley to create a glaze.
Brush the glaze over the chestnut shells, leaving some glaze in the hollows for extra flavor.
Place the glazed chestnuts on the preheated robata grill and cook for 5 minutes, turning occasionally, until the shells are crisp and the glaze is caramelized.
Remove the chestnuts from the grill and let them cool for a minute before serving.
Garnish with additional fresh mint and serve hot.
